data.name: Radha
data.gender_notes: Radha is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root rādh, 'to succeed, to accomplish' — 'prosperity, success'. Its root is Sanskrit rādh (राध्). Radha, the beloved of Krishna. Radha is a Sanskrit name meaning “Prosperity; success; the beloved”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Radha expresses “Prosperity; success; the beloved”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root rādh, 'to succeed, to accomplish' — 'prosperity, success'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Radha total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
